resale_co.name: Certificate of Occupancy for Change of Occupancy (resale inspection)
resale_co.issued_by: Housing Inspector, Property Maintenance and Rental Units Department
resale_co.lead_time: Apply at least three weeks before occupancy; the borough suggests applying when the house is listed
requirements: Exterior walls sound and weatherproof; house numbers at least 3 inches, readable from the street; yard maintained
Garages, fences, walls, stairs, decks, porches sound; driveways and sidewalks without tripping hazards; no big foundation cracks
Porches or landings 30 inches high need rails with openings no more than 4 inches
Roof and chimney sound (roof or chimney certification may be required); no broken glass
No double-keyed deadbolt on the main door (thumb latch required)
Pool fence with self-closing, self-latching gate that swings out (48 inch minimum, 6 ft for inground); no stagnant water; GFCI for pools
Smoke detector on each level and outside sleeping areas (battery allowed); CO detector outside sleeping area (battery allowed)
A:B:C fire extinguisher, no larger than 10 lb, mounted within 10 ft of the kitchen
Mechanical equipment working; no excessive peeling paint, loose plaster or decayed wood; no insect infestation
Handrail 30 to 38 inches on stairs of 5 or more steps; every room has an operable window with screen
Electrical free of hazards: no extension-cord wiring, covers on all boxes, at least 2 outlets per room and 1 per bathroom
Plumbing without leaks, toilets flush, tub and shower watertight; heat to all habitable rooms
Water heater and boiler relief valve pipe ending within 6 inches of the floor; flue pipes sealed
Satisfactory drinking water lab report if not on public water

fees.label: Inspection fee, per unit
fees.quote: A $ 50.00(per unit) fee must accompany the application for inspection.

fees.label: Re-inspection, per unit (charged for each inspection after the second)
fees.quote: Re-inspections will require an additional fee of $35.00 (per unit) and a completed application form. NOTE: If more than two inspections are required, the $35.00 fee shall be charged for each sequential inspection.

resale_co.how_to_apply: Fill out the Application for a Certificate of Occupancy for Change of Occupancy and submit it with the fee to the Inspection Office at Borough Hall, 7 S. Grove Ave, National Park, NJ 08063. Inspectors in the field do not accept applications or fees. The application is not complete until the owner or agent calls 856-845-3891 to schedule. Inspection appointments are only on Thursdays, 12:00 PM to 1:00 PM.

evidence.quote: A Certificate of Occupancy is required in the Borough of National Park every time a residential property changes occupants.
This dwelling is not to be occupied until a certificate of occupancy is issued by the Housing Inspector of the Borough of National Park.
inspect all residential properties when they are being sold
Because of scheduling and processing time, please apply for inspection a minimum of three weeks prior to occupancy.

resale_co.notes: The application PDF is a scanned document with no date, so the $50 / $35 fees could be old; confirm with the office. The same CO applies to any change of occupant, including rentals; the borough also has a rental unit annual registration and inspection program (Ordinance 3-07, Chapter 97). The borough does not inspect air conditioning, pools or spas (beyond electrical and fencing), termites, or lead-based paint. Property Maintenance contact: Ele Hagerty, 7 S. Grove Avenue, hours 7 am to 4 pm Monday to Wednesday, 7 am to 3 pm Thursday.

authorities.name: Gloucester County Fire Marshal's Office (county local enforcing agency)
authorities.how_to_apply: Contact the Gloucester County Office of the Fire Marshal, 212 County House Road, Clarksboro, NJ 08020. No resale smoke/CO/extinguisher certificate form or fee is posted on the county website.

evidence.quote: The County Fire Marshal's Office currently is the Local Enforcement Agency (LEA) for the following municipalities: Clayton East Greenwich Elk National Park Newfield Paulsboro South Harrison Wenonah West Deptford Woodbury Woodbury Heights

fire_cert.notes: The authority is a county agency; the schema's type list has no county option, so type is set to 'unknown' (DCA registry key: 'C = County'). Authority identity is confirmed by both the county page and the DCA registry, but no fee schedule for the county's resale smoke certificates was found on an official page. A search-tool summary claimed National Park fees of $100 / $150 / $200 by lead time and $50 reinspection, citing an ecode360 page whose municipality could not be confirmed; not recorded. The borough's own CO checklist also checks smoke alarms, CO alarm and extinguisher. Chief County Fire Marshal: Shawn Layton, 856-307-7913; office fax 856-224-8284.

other_items.label: Possible trade certifications
other_items.detail: Roofing, chimney, structural, electrical, plumbing or heating certifications may be required by the inspector.

other_items.label: Private water test
other_items.detail: A satisfactory lab report is required for drinking water where public water is not supplied.
